gap_records.summary: Required candidate file for `native_godot_project` is unverified.

task_specification.objective: Deliver one coherent survivor-foundation increment that makes camera-relative movement, dash, pause/reset ownership, authored-arena spatial integrity, and visual upgrade choices directly retestable in the shipped runtime.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has separate input-router, motor, camera, world-contract, lifecycle, and draft-view implementations, but the required player-facing contract is not yet host-verified as one coherent behavior. Cross-owner edge handling, reset cleanup, authored landmark spatial integrity, and choice presentation therefore need an integrated hardening pass.

stop_conditions: Modify only the bounded candidate surface and directly related files.
Preserve the intact authored cemetery and character packages; do not replace, duplicate, hide, extract, or surgically edit imported assets.
Leave live runtime recapture, evidence binding, and pass/fail judgment to GameLoop Runtime and Tester.

strategy.rationale: Repair the shared ownership seams rather than tuning isolated transforms: unify input edges with the Warden motor, make dash and lifecycle resets authoritative, align camera/world collision and occlusion wrappers around the native map, and make the upgrade draft’s visual hierarchy explicit.

code: Run focused static checks on all edited GDScript and scene files; verify no release-only tester actions or imported-package surgery are introduced.
Verify the task is the sole task, covers the exact required gap once, and uses only candidate-relative editable target paths.
runtime: Tester recaptures ordinary WASD movement, release, Space dash, left-stick movement, south-button dash, pause/resume, death or retry reset, and repeated traversal around the central landmark and full perimeter.

Tester binds black-box input events to white-box receipts for camera-relative velocity, collision sliding, facing, dash phase/invulnerability/cooldown generations, camera safe-frame and occluders, landmark collision/visibility, and clean reset.
Tester opens the upgrade draft at native and supported UI scales and exercises keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/selection, confirming debounced commit and resumed play.
visual: Gameplay remains a high-angle perspective composition with readable player, threats, telegraphs, pickups, and escape space; no FPS/TPS camera drift or recurring landmark occlusion.
The authored world reads as a larger traversable cemetery with external depth; the central landmark and perimeter remain visible, collidable, and stable during ordinary movement replay.
Upgrade cards visibly lead with silhouettes/icons and compact truthful deltas, with distinct focus/hover/pressed/unavailable/selected states and no placeholder CURRENT values.

done_when: WASD and left-stick input produce camera-relative planar CharacterBody3D movement with stable collision sliding, independent visual facing, bounded acceleration/deceleration, and no stuck movement after release or context change.

Space and the gamepad south face button each produce exactly one dash transaction with anticipation, active onset, active-only invulnerability, recovery, declared cooldown, direction, and generation receipts; duplicate presses, pause, death, retry, and reset clear pending ownership and contradictory velocity.

The gameplay camera remains a damped high-angle perspective view, never first-person, ADS, shoulder, or free-orbit, and keeps the player, nearby threats, telegraphs, pickups, and an escape lane readable without harmful edge loss or repeated occlusion.

The authored arena demonstrates expand or larger traversable scale, a coherent external world or external depth, and aligned central building or landmark visual footprint and collision; ordinary movement or movement replay along every boundary or perimeter side shows no pass-through, disappearance, or camera-occlusion drift.

The upgrade draft replaces text-stacked choices with a visual hierarchy led by authored weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; unchanged rows are omitted, NEW or LOCKED never appears in CURRENT, copy stays restrained, and keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and chosen/.
tasks.instructions: Update the existing seams in `scripts/input/input_context_router.gd`, `scripts/gameplay/run_controller.gd`, `scripts/player/warden_controller.gd`, and `scripts/camera/arena_camera.gd` so keyboard and gamepad-equivalent movement/dash share one authoritative edge transaction, movement stays camera-relative, dash is interruptible and state-owned, and pause/resume/retry/death cannot leak input, velocity, invulnerability, or camera mode. Use `scripts/world/cemetery_spatial_contract.gd` and `scenes/gameplay/survival_foundation.tscn` only to restore native-map spawn, boundary, landmark collision, camera framing, and bounded occlusion wrappers; retain one intact authored environment instance and its native streets, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks, with no proxy roads or decorative replacement families. In `scripts/ui/upgrade_draft.gd` and `scenes/ui/upgrade_draft.tscn`, implement or preserve the silhouette-first choice hierarchy, compact stat-icon rows, truthful current-to-new deltas (maximum three), placeholder filtering, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. Extend candidate-owned snapshots/receipts where needed so movement source, dash phases/generations, reset ownership, camera safe-frame/occluder state, landmark collision/visibility, and draft interaction state are directly retestable.
tasks.title: Harden survivor movement, dash, spatial integrity, and choice hierarchy
